title: Grafik va jadvalni tasvirlash
goal_uz: Dars oxirida grafik va jadvaldagi trendlarni (o‘sish, pasayish, tebranish) aniq ifodalaysiz, ma'lumotlarni solishtirasiz, raqamsiz overview gapini yozasiz va raqamlarni to‘g‘ri yaxlitlab aytasiz.

scenes.title: Grafik va jadvalni tasvirlash
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda madaniyatlararo farqlarni ko‘rdik: muloyimlik, solishtirish va hurmatli ohang. Bugun yozma nutqning muhim turi bilan shug‘ullanamiz: grafik va jadvalni ingliz tilida tasvirlash. Dars oxirida o‘sish, pasayish va tebranishni aniq ifodalaysiz, ma'lumotlarni solishtirasiz, umumiy xulosa jumlasini yozasiz va raqamlarni to‘g‘ri aytasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Last time we compared cultures. Today we describe graphs and tables. By the end, you will describe trends, compare data, write an overview sentence and use numbers accurately.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun grafik va jadvallarni tasvirlaymiz: trendlar, solishtirish, umumiy xulosa va aniq raqamlar.

scenes.title: Tasvirning to‘rt qismi

examples.t: The graph shows how sales changed between 2018 and 2022.
examples.uz: Grafik 2018 va 2022 yillar orasida savdo qanday o‘zgarganini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi tasvir odatda to‘rt qismdan iborat. Birinchi, kirish: sarlavhani o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta aytasiz. Ikkinchi, umumiy xulosa, ya'ni overview: asosiy yo‘nalish, raqamsiz. Uchinchi va to‘rtinchi, tafsilotlar: muhim raqamlarni guruhlab keltirasiz. Hamma raqamni ro‘yxat qilib sanash eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato. Maqsad: o‘quvchiga rasm ko‘z oldida paydo bo‘lishi.
scenes.say: A good description has four parts. Introduction: paraphrase the title. Overview: the main trend, without numbers. Then two detail paragraphs with key figures, grouped logically. Do not list every number.
scenes.say_uz: Tasvir to‘rt qismdan iborat: kirish, umumiy xulosa (raqamsiz), va ikki tafsilot qismi. Hamma raqamni sanab chiqmang.

scenes.title: Grafik qismlari
board: line graph · bar chart · pie chart · table

examples.t: The horizontal axis shows the years.

scenes.say_native: Avval nomlarni bilib olaylik. Chiziqli grafik line graph, ustunli diagramma bar chart, doiraviy diagramma pie chart, jadval table. O‘qlar: vertikal o‘q vertical axis, gorizontal o‘q horizontal axis. Izoh, ya'ni belgilar ro‘yxati, key deyiladi. Jadvalda ustun column, qator row. Raqam uchun “figure”, ulush uchun “proportion” so‘zini ishlatamiz. Bu so‘zlar kirish gapingizni aniq qiladi.
scenes.say: Line graph, bar chart, pie chart, table. The vertical axis, the horizontal axis, the key, a column and a row. A number is a figure, and a share is a proportion.
scenes.say_uz: Line graph, bar chart, pie chart, table. Vertical va horizontal axis, key, column, row. Figure — raqam, proportion — ulush.

scenes.title: O‘sish fe'llari
board: rise · increase · grow · climb · go up

examples.t: The number of users rose from 20 to 35 million.
There was a steady increase in sales.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: trend lug‘ati. O‘sish uchun fe'llar: “rise”, “increase”, “grow”, “climb”, “go up”. Ot shaklida: “a rise”, “an increase”, “growth”. Ikki shakl bor: “The number rose” yoki “There was a rise in the number”. Ikkinchisi akademik yozuvda ko‘p uchraydi. “Rise” noto‘g‘ri fe'l: rise, rose, risen. Bitta so‘zni takrorlayverish uslubni zaiflashtiradi, shuning uchun sinonimlardan foydalaning.
scenes.say: Verbs for growth: rise, increase, grow, climb, go up. As nouns: a rise, an increase, growth. You can write: the number rose, or: there was a rise in the number. Rise is irregular: rise, rose, risen.
scenes.say_uz: O‘sish fe'llari: rise, increase, grow, climb, go up. Ot shakli: a rise, an increase. Rise — rose — risen.

scenes.title: Pasayish, barqarorlik, tebranish
board: remain stable · stay constant · level off
fluctuate · peak at · reach a low of

examples.t: Sales fell, then levelled off at 50.
Prices fluctuated throughout the year.

scenes.say_native: Pasayish uchun: “fall”, “decrease”, “decline”, “drop”. Fall, fell, fallen noto‘g‘ri fe'l. Barqarorlik uchun: “remain stable”, “stay constant”, “level off”. Tebranish, ya'ni ko‘tarilib-tushish, “fluctuate”. Eng yuqori nuqta: “peak at”. Eng past nuqta: “reach a low of” yoki “bottom out at”. Ushbu fe'llar o‘zbekchada bitta-ikkita so‘z bilan ifodalanadi, inglizchada esa ko‘proq aniq nuanslar bor.
scenes.say: For decline: fall, decrease, decline, drop. For no change: remain stable, stay constant, level off. For ups and downs: fluctuate. The highest point is a peak, and the lowest is a low.
scenes.say_uz: Pasayish: fall, decrease, decline, drop. Barqarorlik: remain stable, level off. Tebranish: fluctuate. Eng yuqori nuqta — peak.

scenes.title: Ravishlar va sifatlar

examples.t: There was a sharp rise in 2020.
Sales fell slightly.

scenes.say_native: Trendning tezligini ravish bilan bildiramiz. Tez o‘zgarish: “sharply”, “dramatically”, “rapidly”. Sekin o‘zgarish: “steadily”, “gradually”, “slowly”. Kichik o‘zgarish: “slightly”, “marginally”. Gapni ikki yo‘l bilan qurasiz: fe'l bilan ravish, “Sales rose sharply”, yoki sifat bilan ot, “There was a sharp rise”. Sifatda -ly yo‘q: “sharp rise”. Bu muhim: “sharply rise” demaysiz.
scenes.say: Describe speed with adverbs: sharply, dramatically, rapidly, steadily, gradually, slightly. Verb plus adverb: sales rose sharply. Adjective plus noun: there was a sharp rise.
scenes.say_uz: Tezlik: sharply, rapidly; sekin: steadily, gradually; kichik: slightly. Fe'l + ravish yoki sifat + ot: sharp rise.

scenes.title: Predloglar

examples.t: It rose from 20 to 35.
It rose by 15.
It peaked at 40.

scenes.say_native: Predloglar ko‘pchilikka qiyin. “From… to…” boshlang‘ich va yakuniy qiymatni beradi: “rose from 20 to 35”. “By” farqni bildiradi: “rose by 15”. “At” darajani bildiradi: “peaked at 40”, “stayed at 50”. Ot shaklida “of” ishlatamiz: “a rise of 15 percent”. O‘zbek tilida bu hammasi “ga” qo‘shimchasi bilan keladi, shuning uchun “to” va “by” ni almashtirib yuborish mumkin. Ehtiyot bo‘ling.
scenes.say: From to gives start and end: rose from 20 to 35. By gives the difference: rose by 15. At gives a level: peaked at 40. After a noun, use of: a rise of fifteen per cent.
scenes.say_uz: From... to... — boshi va oxiri; by — farq; at — daraja; a rise of — ot bilan.

scenes.title: Zamon va vaqt iboralari

examples.t: Between 2015 and 2020, prices rose.
Sales have risen since 2018.

scenes.say_native: Zamon tanlash oson. Grafikdagi yillar o‘tgan bo‘lsa, past simple ishlatamiz: “In 2020, sales fell.” Hozirgacha davom etayotgan davr uchun present perfect: “Sales have risen since 2018.” Kelajak, ya'ni prognoz uchun: “will” yoki “is expected to”: “Sales are expected to reach 80 million by 2030.” Vaqt iboralari: “between 2015 and 2020”, “from 2015 to 2020”, “over the period”, “in 2018”, “by the end of 2022”.
scenes.say: Past dates need the past simple. A period up to now uses the present perfect: sales have risen since 2018. A forecast uses will or is expected to. Use between and and, or from and to.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yillar uchun past simple, hozirgacha davom etgani uchun present perfect, prognoz uchun will yoki is expected to.

scenes.title: Rise va raise, to va by
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi, “raise” va “rise”. “Rise” o‘zi o‘sadi, undan keyin obyekt kelmaydi: “Prices rose”. “Raise” esa kimdir nimanidir ko‘taradi: “The shop raised prices”. “Prices raised” noto‘g‘ri. Ikkinchisi, “by” va “to” ni aralashtirish. “Increased by 15%” degani 15 foizga oshdi, “increased to 35%” esa oxirida 35 foiz bo‘ldi, ya'ni boshqa ma'no. Raqamni yozishdan oldin o‘ylab oling.
scenes.say: Two mistakes. Rise has no object: prices rose. Raise needs an object: the shop raised prices. And by and to differ: increased by fifteen per cent is the change, increased to thirty-five per cent is the end level.
scenes.say_uz: Rise obyektsiz: prices rose. Raise obyekt bilan: the shop raised prices. By — o‘zgarish miqdori, to — oxirgi daraja.

scenes.title: Trendni tasvirlang
board: Describe the changes in three sentences.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qirg‘oq shahriga kelgan sayyohlar soni, ming kishi hisobida: 2019 yilda qirq, 2020 yilda yetmish, 2021 yilda yetmish, 2022 yilda ellik besh. Uchta gap bilan o‘zgarishni tasvirlang. Past simple, ravish va to‘g‘ri predlog ishlating. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Tourists in thousands. Two thousand nineteen: forty. Two thousand twenty: seventy. Two thousand twenty-one: seventy. Two thousand twenty-two: fifty-five. Describe the changes in three sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Sayyohlar (ming): 2019 — 40, 2020 — 70, 2021 — 70, 2022 — 55. Uchta gap bilan tasvirlang.

scenes.title: Javob
board: The number rose sharply from 40,000 to 70,000 in 2020.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. Birinchi: “The number of tourists rose sharply from 40,000 to 70,000 in 2020.” Ikkinchi: “It remained stable at 70,000 in 2021.” Uchinchi: “It then fell to 55,000 in 2022.” Diqqat qiling: “rose”, “remained”, “fell” hammasi past simple, “from… to…”, “at” va “to” ishlatilgan. “Fell by 15,000” ham to‘g‘ri variant bo‘lardi.
scenes.say: The number of tourists rose sharply from forty thousand to seventy thousand in 2020. It remained stable at seventy thousand in 2021. It then fell to fifty-five thousand in 2022.
scenes.say_uz: Sayyohlar soni 2020 yilda 40 000 dan 70 000 gacha keskin o‘sdi, 2021 da 70 000 da qoldi, 2022 da 55 000 ga tushdi.

scenes.title: Taqqoslash qoliplari
board: higher / lower than · the highest / the lowest
twice as high as · three times as many as

examples.t: Cars were twice as common as buses.
examples.uz: Mashinalar avtobuslardan ikki barobar ko‘p edi.

examples.t: Train use was similar to bicycle use.
examples.uz: Poyezd bilan qatnash velosiped bilan qatnashga o‘xshash edi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: ma'lumotlarni solishtirish. Qiyoslash darajasi: “higher than”, “lower than”. Eng yuqori va eng past: “the highest”, “the lowest”. Karrali solishtirish: “twice as high as”, “three times as many as”. O‘xshashlik: “the same as”, “similar to”, “as high as”. Qoida eslatmasi: qisqa sifatga -er, uzun sifatga “more”: “higher”, “more common”. “More higher” kabi ikki marta qo‘llash o‘zbek o‘quvchilarida uchraydigan xato.
scenes.say: Compare with higher than, lower than, the highest, the lowest. For multiples: twice as high as, three times as many as. For similarity: the same as, similar to, as high as.
scenes.say_uz: Higher than, lower than, the highest; twice as high as; the same as, similar to — taqqoslash qoliplari.

scenes.title: Ulush va miqdor
board: the majority · a minority · the largest share

examples.t: Cars accounted for 45 per cent of journeys.
Fewer people cycled than walked.
examples.uz: Velosipedda yurganlar piyoda yurganlardan kam edi.

scenes.say_native: Ulushni ifodalash uchun: “account for”, “make up”, “represent”. Masalan, “Cars accounted for 45 per cent of journeys.” “The majority” ko‘pchilik, “a minority” ozchilik. Sanaladigan otlar bilan “fewer”, “the number of”, sanalmaydigan otlar bilan “less”, “the amount of”: “fewer people”, “less money”. Hozirgi darajada “less people” katta xato emas, lekin yozma tasvirda “fewer people” to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: For shares: account for, make up, represent. The majority, a minority, the largest share. Use fewer with countable nouns and less with uncountable nouns: fewer people, less money.
scenes.say_uz: Ulush: account for, make up. The majority — ko‘pchilik. Fewer — sanaladigan, less — sanalmaydigan otlar bilan.

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshilik bog‘lovchilari
board: by contrast · in contrast · on the other hand

examples.t: Car use rose, whereas bus use fell.
examples.uz: Mashinadan foydalanish ortdi, avtobusdan esa kamaydi.

examples.t: Compared with buses, trains were less popular.
examples.uz: Avtobuslarga nisbatan poyezdlar kamroq mashhur edi.

scenes.say_native: Ikki ma'lumotni qarama-qarshi qo‘yish uchun: “whereas” va “while” dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi. “Compared with” va “unlike” dan keyin ot keladi. Gap boshida “By contrast” yoki “In contrast” keladi va vergul bilan ajratiladi. Oldingi darsda bu bog‘lovchilar madaniyatni solishtirishda ishladi, bugun raqamlar uchun. Ikki gapni bitta uzun gapga birlashtirish ballingizni oshiradi.
scenes.say: To contrast: whereas and while take a full clause. Compared with and unlike take a noun. By contrast and in contrast start a sentence and need a comma.
scenes.say_uz: Whereas va while dan keyin to‘liq gap; compared with va unlike dan keyin ot; by contrast gap boshida.

scenes.title: Taqqoslashdagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchi: “more higher”, “the most highest”: qisqa sifatda faqat -er yoki -est, “higher”, “the highest”. Ikkinchi: “the number of cars are” emas, “the number of cars is”, chunki bosh so‘z “number” birlikda. Faqat “a number of cars are” ko‘plikda. Uchinchi: “less people” emas, “fewer people”. Bu uchtasi yozma ishda ball yo‘qotadi.
scenes.say: Three typical mistakes. More higher is wrong: say higher. The number of cars is singular: the number of cars is rising. And fewer people, not less people.
scenes.say_uz: More higher emas, higher. The number of cars is (birlik). Fewer people, less people emas.

scenes.title: Jadvalni solishtiring
board: Transport to work: car 45% · bus 20% · train 15% · bicycle 12% · walking 8%
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ishga qatnash vositalari: mashina qirq besh foiz, avtobus yigirma, poyezd o‘n besh, velosiped o‘n ikki, piyoda sakkiz foiz. Uchta gap tuzing. Birinchi: mashinani avtobus bilan solishtiring, karrali ibora ishlating. Ikkinchi: velosiped va piyodani solishtiring. Uchinchi: avtobus va poyezd birgalikda qancha ulush tashkil qiladi?
scenes.say: Transport to work. Car forty-five per cent. Bus twenty. Train fifteen. Bicycle twelve. Walking eight. Compare car and bus, bicycle and walking, and describe bus plus train together.
scenes.say_uz: Mashina 45%, avtobus 20%, poyezd 15%, velosiped 12%, piyoda 8%. Mashina va avtobusni, velosiped va piyodani solishtiring, avtobus + poyezd ulushini tasvirlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Cars were more than twice as common as buses.
2) Cycling was four percentage points higher than walking.
3) Bus and train together made up just over a third.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: qirq besh yigirmadan ikki barobardan ko‘p, shuning uchun “more than twice as common as”. Ikkinchi: o‘n ikki bilan sakkiz orasidagi farq to‘rt foiz punkti, “four percentage points”. Ikkinchi so‘z muhim: foiz punkti ulushlar farqi, foiz esa nisbiy o‘zgarish. Uchinchi: yigirma plyus o‘n besh o‘ttiz besh, bu uchdan birdan ozgina ko‘p, “just over a third”.
scenes.say: Cars were more than twice as common as buses. Cycling was four percentage points higher than walking. Bus and train together made up just over a third.
scenes.say_uz: Mashina avtobusdan ikki barobardan ko‘p; velosiped piyodadan 4 foiz punkt yuqori; avtobus va poyezd birgalikda uchdan biridan ozgina ko‘p.

scenes.title: Overview nima?
board: Main trend · biggest / smallest · one contrast

examples.t: Overall, sales rose, although there was one slight dip.
examples.uz: Umuman, savdo o‘sdi, garchi bir marta ozgina pasayish bo‘lgan.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: umumiy xulosa jumlasi. U eng muhim jumla, chunki imtihonchilar uni qidiradi. Overview katta rasmni beradi: asosiy yo‘nalish o‘sishmi yoki pasayishmi, eng katta va eng kichik narsa nima, bitta muhim qarama-qarshilik bormi. Unda batafsil raqam bo‘lmaydi. Masalan: “Overall, sales rose, although there was one slight dip.” Bunday gap o‘quvchiga mazmunni bir nafasda tushuntiradi.
scenes.say: The overview gives the big picture: the main trend, the biggest and smallest items, one key contrast. It contains no detailed numbers. For example: overall, sales rose, although there was one slight dip.
scenes.say_uz: Overview — katta rasm: asosiy trend, eng katta va eng kichik, bitta qarama-qarshilik. Batafsil raqamsiz.

scenes.title: Overview iboralari
board: The most striking feature is that …

examples.t: It is clear that online shopping grew rapidly.
The most striking feature is the sharp rise in 2020.
examples.uz: Eng e'tiborli jihat 2020 yildagi keskin o‘sish.

scenes.say_native: Overview ni boshlash uchun tayyor iboralar: “Overall”, “In general”, “It is clear that”, “The most striking feature is that”. Misol: “It is clear that online shopping grew rapidly.” Yoki “The most striking feature is the sharp rise in 2020.” Bu iboralar yangi gap boshida turadi, ayrim holda “Overall,” dan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. Hammasini bir xil ishlatmang, ikkitasini almashtirib turing.
scenes.say: Start the overview with overall, in general, it is clear that, or the most striking feature is that. Vary your phrases and avoid repeating the same one.
scenes.say_uz: Overview iboralari: overall, in general, it is clear that, the most striking feature is that. Takrorlamang.

scenes.title: Kirish gapi
board: the number of → the figure for
between 2018 and 2022 → over a four-year period

examples.t: The line graph illustrates changes in coffee sales between 2018 and 2022.
examples.uz: Chiziqli grafik 2018 va 2022 yillar oralig‘ida qahva savdosidagi o‘zgarishlarni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Kirish gapi sarlavhani qayta ifodalaydi. Sarlavhani aynan ko‘chirmang. “Shows” o‘rniga “illustrates”, “presents” yoki “compares” deng. “The number of” o‘rniga “the figure for”. “Between 2018 and 2022” o‘rniga “over a four-year period”. Masalan: “The line graph illustrates changes in coffee sales between 2018 and 2022.” Bu gapda faqat bir narsa aytiladi: nima haqida va qaysi davr.
scenes.say: The introduction paraphrases the title. Instead of shows, use illustrates or presents. Replace the number of with the figure for. For example: the line graph illustrates changes in coffee sales between 2018 and 2022.
scenes.say_uz: Kirish sarlavhani boshqa so‘zlar bilan aytadi: shows o‘rniga illustrates, the number of o‘rniga the figure for.

scenes.title: Overview dagi xatolar
board: ✗ I think sales rose because people like coffee.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi, fikr va sabab qo‘shish: “I think sales rose because people like coffee.” Grafik tasvirida sizdan faqat ma'lumotni tasvirlash talab qilinadi, sabab o‘ylab topish emas. Ikkinchisi, overview ga hamma raqamni qo‘yish. Overview raqamsiz bo‘ladi, raqamlar keyingi qismlarda keladi. Birinchi shaxsdan ham qoching: “I think” o‘rniga “It is clear that” deng.
scenes.say: Two mistakes. Do not add opinions or invented reasons. And do not put detailed numbers in the overview. Avoid I think. Say: it is clear that.
scenes.say_uz: Fikr va sabab qo‘shmang. Overview ga batafsil raqam qo‘ymang. I think o‘rniga it is clear that deng.

scenes.title: Overview yozing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qahvaxona savdosi, ming funt hisobida: 2018 yilda bir yuz yigirma, 2019 da bir yuz ellik, 2020 da bir yuz qirq, 2021 da ikki yuz yigirma, 2022 da uch yuz o‘n. Bitta overview gapi ayting: asosiy yo‘nalish va bitta istisno. Raqam keltirmang.
scenes.say: Coffee shop sales in thousands of pounds. Two thousand eighteen: one hundred twenty. Nineteen: one fifty. Twenty: one forty. Twenty-one: two twenty. Twenty-two: three ten. Say one overview sentence, without numbers.
scenes.say_uz: Qahvaxona savdosi (ming funt): 120, 150, 140, 220, 310. Raqamsiz bitta overview gapi ayting.

scenes.title: Javob
board: Overall, sales rose, despite a slight dip in 2020.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. “Overall, sales rose over the period, despite a slight dip in 2020.” Agar xohlasangiz, ikkinchi gap qo‘shing: “The sharpest growth came in 2022.” Bu yerda raqam yo‘q, faqat yo‘nalish va istisno. Savdo 120 dan 310 gacha o‘sgan, bu ikki baravardan ko‘p, lekin bu tafsilot keyingi qismda. “Despite” dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi.
scenes.say: Overall, sales rose over the period, despite a slight dip in 2020. The sharpest growth came in 2022.
scenes.say_uz: Umuman, savdo davr davomida o‘sdi, 2020 da ozgina pasayish bo‘lsa ham. Eng tez o‘sish 2022 da bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy tasvir
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq namuna tinglang. Unda kirish, overview va tafsilot bor. Qaysi gap qaysi vazifani bajarishini aniqlang. Kirish sarlavhani qayta aytadi, overview raqamsiz, tafsilotlar esa raqamlar bilan guruhlab beriladi.
scenes.say: The line graph illustrates changes in coffee sales between 2018 and 2022. Overall, sales rose, despite a slight dip in 2020. Sales started at 120,000 pounds in 2018 and reached 150,000 in 2019 before falling slightly to 140,000. After that, they rose sharply, to 220,000 in 2021 and 310,000 in 2022.
scenes.say_uz: Chiziqli grafik 2018–2022 yillardagi qahva savdosini ko‘rsatadi. Umuman, savdo o‘sdi. 2018 da 120 000 funt edi, 2019 da 150 000 ga yetdi, so‘ng 140 000 ga tushdi. Keyin keskin o‘sib, 2021 da 220 000, 2022 da 310 000 bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: o‘qituvchi va talaba
board: Bek: In 2012, 20 per cent bought online…
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Onlayn xaridlar grafigi haqida o‘qituvchi va talaba gaplashadi. Talaba Bek tasvirni boshlaydi. O‘qituvchi nimadir tuzatadi. Nima ekanini eshiting.
scenes.say: Bek, how would you begin? Well, in 2012, twenty per cent of people bought online, in 2016 it was forty-five, and in 2020 seventy. Good numbers, but start with the overview. Okay. Overall, online shopping rose steadily. Exactly. Then add the details.
scenes.say_uz: Bek, qanday boshlaysan? 2012 da odamlarning 20 foizi onlayn xarid qilgan, 2016 da 45, 2020 da 70. Raqamlar yaxshi, lekin overview dan boshla. Umuman, onlayn xarid barqaror o‘sdi. Aynan. Keyin tafsilot qo‘sh.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari
board: 2) What did the teacher want first?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: 2012 yilda ko‘rsatkich qancha edi? Ikkinchi: o‘qituvchi avval nimani xohladi? Uchinchi: umumiy trend nima? Qisqa javob bering.
scenes.say: One: what was the figure in 2012? Two: what did the teacher want first? Three: what is the overall trend?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: 2012 yilda ko‘rsatkich qancha edi? Ikki: o‘qituvchi avval nimani xohladi? Uch: umumiy trend nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: yigirma foiz. Ikkinchi: umumiy xulosa, ya'ni overview. Uchinchi: barqaror o‘sish, “a steady rise”. Bek raqamlarni to‘g‘ri aytgan, lekin tartib noto‘g‘ri bo‘lgan: avval katta rasm, keyin tafsilot. Bu xato juda tez-tez uchraydi.
scenes.say: One: twenty per cent. Two: the overview. Three: a steady rise. Bek's numbers were right, but the order was wrong: big picture first, then details.
scenes.say_uz: 20 foiz; overview; barqaror o‘sish. Bekning raqamlari to‘g‘ri edi, tartib noto‘g‘ri edi.

scenes.title: Yaqinlashtirish so‘zlari
board: just over · just under · nearly · almost

examples.t: Approximately 50 per cent of users were under 30.
examples.uz: Foydalanuvchilarning taxminan 50 foizi 30 yoshdan kichik edi.

examples.t: Just under a third of people walked.
examples.uz: Odamlarning uchdan biridan ozgina kami piyoda yurdi.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: raqamlar. Aniq raqam yozish shart emas, yaxlitlash ham mumkin. “About”, “around”, “roughly”, “approximately” taxminiy qiymat uchun. “Just over” biroz ko‘p, “just under” biroz kam. “Nearly” va “almost” raqamga juda yaqin, lekin yetmagan. “Well over” anchagina ko‘p. Rasmiy yozuvda “approximately” yaxshi. Lekin “exactly” bilan taxminiylikni aralashtirmang.
scenes.say: For approximate figures, use about, around, roughly or approximately. Just over means slightly more, just under slightly less. Nearly and almost mean close but not quite. Well over means much more.
scenes.say_uz: Taxminiy: about, around, roughly, approximately. Just over — biroz ko‘p, just under — biroz kam. Nearly, almost — yetmagan.

scenes.title: Kasrlar va foizlar

examples.t: One in four commuters cycled.
examples.uz: Har to‘rt qatnovchidan biri velosipedda yurdi.

examples.t: The majority drove to work.

scenes.say_native: Foizni kasr bilan ifodalash tilni boyitadi. Yigirma besh foiz bu “a quarter” yoki “one in four”. Taxminan o‘ttiz uch foiz “a third”. Ellik foiz “half”. Yetmish besh foiz “three quarters”. Ellik foizdan ko‘pi “the majority”. Britaniyada “per cent” ikkita so‘z, Amerikada odatda “percent” bitta so‘z. “Per cent” ga -s qo‘shilmaydi: “twenty per cent”, “twenty percents” emas.
scenes.say: Twenty-five per cent is a quarter or one in four. About thirty-three per cent is a third. Fifty per cent is half. Seventy-five per cent is three quarters. More than fifty per cent is the majority. No s on per cent.
scenes.say_uz: 25% — a quarter; 33% — a third; 50% — half; 75% — three quarters. Per cent ga -s qo‘shilmaydi.

scenes.title: Raqamlarni o‘qish
board: 0.5 → nought point five · 3.75 → three point seven five

examples.t: The figure reached 3.5 million.

scenes.say_native: Raqamlarni o‘qish qoidalari. Ikki ming besh yuz: “two thousand five hundred”. Britaniyada yuzdan keyin “and” keladi: “two hundred and fifty”, Amerikada ko‘pincha tushiriladi. O‘nli kasr: nuqta “point” deb o‘qiladi, 0,5 “nought point five” yoki “zero point five”, 3,75 “three point seven five”. Million va yuz ko‘plik qo‘shimchasini olmaydi: “three million”, “two hundred”. Yillar: 2015 “twenty fifteen”, 1998 “nineteen ninety-eight”.
scenes.say: Read numbers carefully. Two thousand five hundred. In British English, two hundred and fifty. Decimals use point: nought point five, three point seven five. Million has no s after a number: three million. Years: twenty fifteen, nineteen ninety-eight.
scenes.say_uz: 2500 — two thousand five hundred; 250 — two hundred and fifty (Britaniya). 0.5 — nought point five. Three million, ko‘plik qo‘shimchasiz.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: thirteen va thirty

examples.t: Thirteen or thirty?

scenes.say_native: Raqamli tasvirda eng xavfli narsa “-teen” va “-ty” ni aralashtirish. “Thirteen” da urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda va unli cho‘ziq: /ˌθɜːˈtiːn/. “Thirty” da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, oxiri qisqa va kuchsiz: /ˈθɜːti/. Xuddi shunday fourteen va forty, fifteen va fifty. Amerika ingliz tilida thirty dagi t ko‘pincha d ga o‘xshab eshitiladi. Yozma tasvirda ham, tinglashda ham farqni sezish muhim.
scenes.say: Teen and ty are easy to confuse. In thirteen, the stress falls on the last syllable and the vowel is long. In thirty, the stress is on the first syllable and the ending is short and weak. Same for fourteen and forty.
scenes.say_uz: -teen: urg‘u oxirida, unli cho‘ziq; -ty: urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, oxiri qisqa. Thirteen, thirty; fourteen, forty.

scenes.title: Raqamlarni ayting
scenes.say_native: Ovoz chiqarib ayting. Birinchi: o‘n uch va o‘ttiz. Ikkinchi: ikki ming besh yuz va uch butun yetmish besh. Uchinchi: qirq besh foiz va ikki yuz ellik. To‘rtinchi: ming to‘qqiz yuz to‘qson sakkiz va ikki ming o‘n besh. Britaniya uslubida ayting.
scenes.say: Say these aloud. Thirteen and thirty. Two thousand five hundred and three point seven five. Forty-five per cent and two hundred and fifty. Nineteen ninety-eight and twenty fifteen.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2,500: two thousand five hundred · 3.75: three point seven five
45%: forty-five per cent · 250: two hundred and fifty
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. “Thirteen” oxirida urg‘u, “thirty” boshida. “Two thousand five hundred” va “three point seven five”. “Forty-five per cent” va “two hundred and fifty”. “Nineteen ninety-eight” va “twenty fifteen”. Agar ikki yuz ellikni “two hundred fifty” desangiz, Amerika uslubi bo‘ladi, bu ham to‘g‘ri. Asosiysi, “-teen” va “-ty” ni aniq ajratish.
scenes.say: Thirteen has end stress, thirty has first-syllable stress. Two thousand five hundred. Three point seven five. Forty-five per cent. Two hundred and fifty. Nineteen ninety-eight. Twenty fifteen.
scenes.say_uz: Thirteen oxirida urg‘u, thirty boshida. Barcha raqamlar to‘g‘ri o‘qilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Aniqlikdagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Uch xato. Birinchi: taxminiylik bilan aniqlikni aralashtirish, “about exactly”. Yoki “about”, yoki “exactly”. Ikkinchi: ko‘plik qo‘shimchasi, “twenty percents”, “ten millions” emas, “twenty per cent”, “ten million”. Uchinchi: haddan tashqari aniq raqam, “approximately 23.47%”. Taxminiy deb yozsangiz, yaxlitlang: “just under a quarter”. Aniq va tabiiy raqamlar tasvirni o‘qishga oson qiladi.
scenes.say: Three mistakes. Do not mix about and exactly. No s on per cent or million after a number. And do not give long decimals with approximately: say just under a quarter.
scenes.say_uz: About exactly emas. Per cent va million ga -s qo‘shilmaydi. Approximately bilan uzun o‘nli kasr yozmang.

scenes.title: Yaxlitlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta raqamni mos ibora bilan yaxlitlang. Birinchi: qirq to‘qqiz foiz. Ikkinchi: yigirma olti foiz. Uchinchi: yetmish to‘rt foiz. To‘rtinchi: ellik bir foiz. “Nearly”, “just over”, “a quarter”, “half”, “three quarters” dan foydalaning.
scenes.say: Round these. One: forty-nine per cent. Two: twenty-six per cent. Three: seventy-four per cent. Four: fifty-one per cent.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Qirq to‘qqiz foiz: “nearly half”. Yigirma olti foiz: “just over a quarter”. Yetmish to‘rt foiz: “almost three quarters”. Ellik bir foiz: “just over half”, va shu bilan “the majority” ham to‘g‘ri. “Nearly” va “almost” raqamga yetmaganda, “just over” oshganda ishlatiladi. Bu juft ko‘p ball keltiradi.
scenes.say: Forty-nine: nearly half. Twenty-six: just over a quarter. Seventy-four: almost three quarters. Fifty-one: just over half.
scenes.say_uz: 49% — nearly half; 26% — just over a quarter; 74% — almost three quarters; 51% — just over half.

scenes.title: Tinglang: jadval haqida
board: Rita and Sam prepare a presentation.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Ikki hamkasb, Rita va Sam, prezentatsiyaga tayyorlanyapti. Ular jadvaldagi bo‘limlar bo‘yicha xodimlar sonini ko‘rib chiqishmoqda. Raqamlarni va solishtirishni eshiting.
scenes.say: So, which department is the largest? Sales, with one hundred and twenty staff, which is nearly half of all employees. And the smallest? HR, with only fifteen. What about Support? Eighty-five, more than twice as many as IT, which has forty.
scenes.say_uz: Eng katta bo‘lim qaysi? Savdo, 120 xodim bilan, bu barcha xodimlarning deyarli yarmi. Eng kichigi? HR, atigi 15. Support-chi? 85, IT dan ikki barobardan ko‘p, IT da 40 ta.

scenes.title: Savollar
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: eng katta bo‘lim qaysi va qancha xodim bor? Ikkinchi: eng kichik bo‘lim qaysi? Uchinchi: Support va IT ni qanday solishtirishdi?
scenes.say: One: which is the largest department and how many staff? Two: which is the smallest? Three: how did they compare Support and IT?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: eng katta bo‘lim va xodimlar soni? Ikki: eng kichik bo‘lim? Uch: Support va IT qanday solishtirildi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) Support has more than twice as many as IT
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Sales, bir yuz yigirma xodim, deyarli yarmi. Ikkinchi: HR, o‘n besh. Uchinchi: Support da IT dan ikki barobardan ko‘p xodim bor: sakson besh qirqqa nisbatan. Eshitdingizmi, ular taxminiy ibora va karrali solishtirishni qanday ishlatishdi? Siz ham yozma ishda aynan shunday qiling.
scenes.say: One: Sales, one hundred and twenty, nearly half. Two: HR, fifteen. Three: Support has more than twice as many staff as IT.
scenes.say_uz: Sales 120, deyarli yarmi; HR 15; Support da IT dan ikki barobardan ko‘p xodim bor.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: tasvirlang
board: Use: nearly · more than twice · whereas
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. Bo‘limlar jadvalini ingliz tilida to‘rt gap bilan tasvirlang: kirish, overview va ikkita tafsilot. Kamida bitta taxminiy ibora va bitta bog‘lovchi ishlating. Esda tuting: overview da raqam yo‘q. Boshlang.
scenes.say: Final task. Describe the staff table in four sentences: an introduction, an overview and two details. Use at least one approximation and one contrast word.
scenes.say_uz: Jadvalni to‘rt gapda tasvirlang: kirish, overview, ikki tafsilot. Taxminiy ibora va bog‘lovchi ishlating.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: The table presents the number of staff in four departments.
Overall, Sales is the largest, while HR is the smallest.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Birinchi gap kirish: “The table presents the number of staff in four departments.” Ikkinchi overview: “Overall, Sales is by far the largest department, whereas HR is the smallest.” Uchinchi: “Sales has 120 staff, nearly half of the total.” To‘rtinchi: “Support has more than twice as many employees as IT.” Sizniki farq qilsa ham bo‘ladi, tartib va aniqlik muhim.
scenes.say: The table presents the number of staff in four departments. Overall, Sales is by far the largest, whereas HR is the smallest. Sales has one hundred and twenty staff, nearly half of the total. Support has more than twice as many employees as IT.
scenes.say_uz: Jadval to‘rt bo‘limdagi xodimlar sonini ko‘rsatadi. Umuman, Sales eng katta, HR eng kichik. Sales da 120 xodim, deyarli yarmi. Support da IT dan ikki barobardan ko‘p xodim bor.

scenes.title: Yakuniy takrorlash
board: Trends: rise · fall · fluctuate · level off
Numbers: nearly · just over · per cent
scenes.say_native: Jamlaymiz. Birinchi: trend lug‘ati, rise, fall, fluctuate, level off, ravishlar va to‘g‘ri predloglar: from, to, by, at. Ikkinchi: solishtirish, than, as as, whereas. Uchinchi: overview, raqamsiz, kirishdan keyin. To‘rtinchi: aniq raqamlar va yaxlitlash, nearly, just over, per cent. Va doim esda tuting: “rose”, “raised” emas.
scenes.say: Trends: rise, fall, fluctuate, level off, with the right prepositions. Comparing: than, as as, whereas. The overview has no numbers. Use approximation words and read numbers correctly.
scenes.say_uz: Trend lug‘ati, solishtirish, raqamsiz overview va to‘g‘ri yaxlitlash: bugungi asosiy fikrlar.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: Write a 150-word description of a chart.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: istalgan grafik yoki jadvalni tanlang, masalan, gazeta yoki internetdan, va uni taxminan bir yuz ellik so‘zda ingliz tilida yozib tasvirlang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kirish, raqamsiz overview, kamida to‘rtta trend yoki taqqoslash iborasi va kamida ikkita taxminiy raqam bo‘lsa. Keyingi darsda B2 darajasi uchun imtihon strategiyasini o‘rganamiz. Ko‘rishguncha!
scenes.say: Your homework: choose a chart or table and write a hundred and fifty word description. Include an introduction, an overview without numbers, trend or comparison language, and approximations. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: grafik yoki jadvalni 150 so‘zda tasvirlang. Kirish, raqamsiz overview, trend va taxminiy raqamlar bo‘lsin.

homework_uz: Istalgan grafik yoki jadvalni tanlab, uni ingliz tilida taxminan 150 so‘zda tasvirlang. Mezon: kirish gapi, raqamsiz overview, kamida to‘rtta trend yoki taqqoslash iborasi va kamida ikkita taxminiy raqam.

quiz.why_uz: Rise — rose — risen, obyektsiz fe'l. Raised obyekt talab qiladi.

options: Sales grew 20 per cent more than before
Sales were 20 per cent of the total
quiz.why_uz: By o‘zgarish miqdorini bildiradi; to esa oxirgi darajani.

options: Overall, sales rose despite a slight dip.
quiz.why_uz: Overview katta rasmni beradi, batafsil raqamsiz va fikrsiz.

options: The number of cars are rising.
The number of cars is rising.
The numbers of car is rising.
quiz.why_uz: The number of — birlik, shuning uchun is.

options: Twenty per cents of people agreed.
Twenty per cent of people agreed.

quiz.q: Choose the correct pair: 'Fewer ___ cycled than walked.'
quiz.why_uz: Fewer sanaladigan ko‘plik ot bilan: fewer people.
Thirteen /ˌθɜːˈtiːn/ da urg‘u -teen da; thirty da birinchi bo‘g‘inda.
Whereas dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi; unlike va compared with dan keyin ot.

options: The graph shows the graph about sales.
The line graph illustrates changes in sales between 2018 and 2022.
I will talk about a graph.
quiz.why_uz: Kirish sarlavhani boshqa so‘zlar bilan qayta aytadi va davrni beradi.
